$comment: THE BRAND SLOT'S INPUT. This file belongs to the demo, not to the theme. theme-default ships it holding its own neutral values, so it is a true description of the unbranded site. A demo rewrites it in a demo-local copy of the layer and generates three things from it before delivery: (1) the css section into the token block of brand.css beside this file; (2) schemes into System/Styles/ColorSchemes/default.css AND default.json, typography into the Typography pair and buttons into the Buttons pair, both files of each pair in the same pass (block #19 of default_custom.css: the .css is generated from the .json, and editing one alone is reverted by the next design save); (3) logo and favicon into the Swift-v2_Logo paragraphs and the Swift-v2_Master Favicon, AppleTouchIcon and MetaImage fields, which are content, not theme files. Scheme ids are fixed: they are the seven ids every serialized colorSchemeId in the Distribution names. accent is optional per scheme; when set, the generator writes --dw-color-accent, -rgb and -contrast into the scheme css AND CustomColors entries accent and accent-contrast into the json, or an admin Styles save drops it. Contrast inks are chosen by measured WCAG ratio (4.5:1 minimum against the fill), never by a lightness threshold (README, Foundry #1184). Nothing in the theme reads this file at runtime.
